Description: ESP32-C3-DevKitM-1 (RISC-V single-core, 4MB flash)

Notes: Stacked-host flavor (canary-vision-xiao-c3/-s3 build envs; device guide section 3) - zero wiring, replaces U1+CBL2. USB-Cs must face the same direction when seating. Printed enclosure ENC2 host=xiao targets this

Description: Grove Vision AI V2 (Himax WiseEye2 HX6538, Arm Cortex-M55 + Ethos-U55)
Notes: I2C on GPIO4 (SDA) / GPIO5 (SCL); Seeed product 5851, SKU 101021112 = the HX6538 V2. NOT the older HX6537-A V1 (SKU 101021040 / DigiKey 114992866, OV2640) — those were wrong here. Camera sold separately on some SKUs. Board-only list $15.99 (verified mid-2026)

Description: Grove 4-pin cable
Notes: Usually ships with U2; connects U2 to U1

Description: USB-C cable, data-capable (not charge-only)
Notes: Power + flashing

Description: WS2812B addressable RGB LED (5050)
Notes: EXT_LED=GPIO3; onboard LED_BUILTIN=GPIO8

Description: Resistor 330 ohm 1/8W 0805 (WS2812 data series)
Notes: In series with WS2812 DIN

Description: Capacitor 0.1uF 50V X7R 0805 (WS2812 decoupling)
Notes: Local bypass at DLED1 V+/GND; recommended close to WS2812B power pins

Description: Tactile push button 6mm momentary (multifunction)
Notes: Parallel to BOOT/GPIO9; or reuse onboard BOOT. Indoor; see WAP BOM SW1-ALT for outdoor

Description: Passive piezo buzzer (UNPOPULATED - not in Vision firmware build)
Notes: BUZZER_PIN_DEFAULT=GPIO2; requires firmware fork (FEATURE_AUDIBLE_CHIRP off on Vision)

Description: Battery (PROTECTED pack) + chemistry-matched external charger (C3 DevKit has NO charger)
Notes: SAFETY-CRITICAL - see build plan section 6.5/9.2. Certified protected cells only (IEC 62133/UL); temperature-gated charger. Indoor: LiPo. Outdoor: LiFePO4 w/ temp cutoff or Li-SOCl2 primary

Description: Polycarbonate enclosure w/ clear lid (Hammond 1554/1555 + clear lid); camera window
Notes: UV-stabilized IP66/NEMA4X, -40 to +110C. Clear lid = camera aperture for Grove Vision AI V2; keep optically clear (no smoke tint)

Description: OV5647 camera module, Raspberry Pi cam v1.3 form (25 x 24 mm, 21 x 12.5 mm M2 holes), FPC to CSI
Notes: Required for the printed-enclosure path (mounts to the front-face posts); -62/-67/-160 FOV variants supported by U2; some U2 kit SKUs include it

Description: 3D-printed Canary Vision enclosure (back + front + bracket + knob)
Notes: Parametric OpenSCAD in docs/hardware/enclosure/; GoPro-compatible adjustable hinge with detent teeth; weather preset is ~IP54 splash-resistant - NOT an ENC1 substitute for harsh exposure

Description: M2 self-tapping pan-head screws, mixed lengths: Vision case 4x 6mm (camera posts) + 6x 8mm (back plate to the shell's post ends); doorbell v0.8 4x 5mm (camera posts) + 2x 4mm (module board posts) + 12x 10mm (back plate, over a 2 mm head floor)
Notes: Black-oxide pan heads look best. The doorbell's plate screws grew 8 -> 10 mm in v0.7 (head_floor = 2.0 under every recessed head) and 8 -> 12 of them in v0.8 (the speaker zone's mid posts keep the gasket clamp span under 40 mm); the camera posts there take 5 mm; the board posts take 4 mm. gen_hardware.py --check joins this row to each case's echoed hardware

Description: M5 x 25 bolt + nut (or GoPro-style M5 knurled thumbscrew)
Notes: Hinge clamp; the printed knob part captures a standard M5 nut

Description: #8 / M4 countersunk screw + wall anchor (bracket fixing)
Notes: Bracket wall mounting; or hang on the bracket's keyhole slots

Description: 1/4-20 hex nut (tripod mount, captive in bracket)
Notes: Drops into the bracket's rear pocket; any standard tripod stud threads in

Description: Clear disc 14 x 1 mm, PMMA or polycarbonate (lens window)
Notes: Vision case: bond into the front-face seat with NEUTRAL-CURE silicone (acid-cure attacks PC). Doorbell v0.7: the disc goes in from the INSIDE behind the face's lip and the printed retainer ring (part="retainer") presses in behind it - run a thin bead of neutral-cure silicone round the lip's ledge before the disc so the window seals; no bridges face the window. For sealing also see WAP BOM items 23-26 (silicone, USB plug, TPU, GORE vent)

Description: M2 brass heat-set insert, short series 3.5mm OD x 4.0mm (4x front corners + 1x doorbell security boss)
Notes: Service-grade threads: set screw_insert=true (posts auto-fatten; the doorbell cavity widens for the nut arc), install at 220-240C (PETG) / 240-260C (ASA), use M2 machine screws for the front corners AND the security screw (SCR8 machine variant). Vision case builds need 4; the fifth seats in the doorbell body's security boss from the outer face

Description: 12mm panel-mount illuminated momentary button, SHORT body, IP65+, ring LED - 6 V LED version (yellow = canary; any color works), momentary SPST-NO with separate LED + / - terminals
Notes: Doorbell enclosure face (canary_vision_doorbell.scad). Switch: C to GND, NO to XIAO D1 through R5 (GPIO2 on the S3, GPIO3 on the C3; internal pull-up). LED: + to XIAO 5V, - to Q1 collector - never straight to a GPIO. Buy the 6 V version (its LED carries its own resistor); a 3 V version needs a 100 ohm resistor in series with LED+. Body+terminals <= 18mm behind panel (btn_body_l is assert-checked). Wiring: docs/hardware/canary_vision_doorbell_wiring.md

Description: NPN transistor 2N3904, TO-92 (glow ring low-side switch)
Notes: Doorbell glow: collector to BTN2 LED -, emitter to GND, base from XIAO D2 through R3. Any small NPN (BC547, 2N2222, MMBT3904) works at the ring's ~10-20 mA

Description: Resistor 1k ohm 1/4W (Q1 base)
Notes: XIAO D2 (GPIO3 on the S3, GPIO4 on the C3) to Q1 base: ~2 mA of base drive, plenty to saturate Q1 at the ring's current

Description: Resistor 10k ohm 1/4W (Q1 base pull-down)
Notes: Q1 base to GND: holds the ring dark while D2 is high-impedance (boot, and every Vision that never turns its doorbell on)

Description: Resistor 1k ohm 1/4W (button series, ESD)
Notes: BTN2 NO terminal to XIAO D1: limits the current a static zap on the outdoor button can push into the pin. With C2 it also filters wiring noise

Description: Capacitor 100nF 50V ceramic (button filter)
Notes: XIAO D1 to GND, at the XIAO end: with R5, a ~0.1 ms filter - far below the firmware's 30 ms debounce, so it never eats a press

Description: M2 x 10 security screw (Torx pin / tri-wing): self-tapping thread for the default body, MACHINE thread when screw_insert=true
Notes: Doorbell anti-theft lock: drives up through the wall plate's collar into the body's blind boss - tool-only removal, Ring-style. With screw_insert=true the boss carries INS1's fifth insert, so use the M2 machine-thread variant (a self-tapper strips brass)

Description: Cable grommet / bushing for a 14x10mm oval (or seal with neutral-cure silicone)
Notes: Doorbell rear cable exit (14 x 10 in v0.7, was 12 x 7); pair with a right-angle USB-C plug - the wall plate's pass is a slot that runs the 8 mm drop, so the plug rides the slide

Description: O-ring 2 mm ID x 1 mm CS (M2 screw-head seal, printed enclosure)
Notes: Outdoor Vision and doorbell: one under each back screw's pan head (12 on the v0.8 doorbell; 6 with the mid-span gasket posts), in the glands the sealed back seats carry (e_gland). NBR or silicone 70A

Description: LiPo cell 802030 class (8 x 20 x 30 mm, 400-450 mAh, 3.7 V) WITH protection circuit (PCM), JST-PH 2.0 leads
Notes: Doorbell v0.7 battery bay (opt_batt): ride-through for a USB supply that browns out. The XIAO's own charger charges it (ESP32-C3 ~370 mA = <1C on this cell, the one size in the 20 x 30 family that is; ESP32-S3 100 mA). Solder the leads to the XIAO's BAT+/BAT- pads BEFORE seating it in the module - the pads face the module. NEITHER XIAO CHARGER HAS A COLD CUTOFF: a LiPo must not charge below 0 C, so outdoors in a freezing climate LEAVE THE CELL OUT (cold_weather_envelope.md); the bay is for mild climates and sheltered porches. Protected cells only (IEC 62133 / UL)

Description: Foam tape strip, 0.5 x 6 x 30 mm, double-sided acrylic (battery bay floor)
Notes: Under BT2 on the doorbell plate: takes up the bay's clearance and keeps the cell off the plate's layer lines. One strip, cut from a roll

Description: FPC Wi-Fi antenna 2.4 GHz, 40 x 20 mm, u.FL pigtail (the XIAO ESP32-C3 kit antenna; S3: 37.4 x 17.5 A-02)
Notes: Doorbell v0.7 antenna landing (opt_ant): stuck to the +X wall's inner face between two ribs, its plane across the cavity, the +X mid posts standing 1 mm off the wall so it passes behind them; pigtail under the module to the XIAO's u.FL. Ships with the XIAO ESP32-C3 - no extra purchase on that host

Description: Speaker: 36 mm sealed full-range driver, 4 ohm, 3 W class, >= 88 dB/W/m, <= 6 mm deep, plastic frame (mylar cone, sealed back)
Notes: Doorbell v0.8 (opt_spk): the chime on a sealed ring, the tick on a repeat, the three reply TONES. Seated rim-first in the face's boss over FOAM2, its magnet pressed by the plate's cradle through FOAM3 - no screws. Target: carries over a 70-75 dB street; the arithmetic with AMP1 (2.5 W) says ~90 dB at 1 m before case losses, UNMETERED until a bench unit exists. VERIFY the part in hand against spk_d / spk_h / spk_mag_d before printing; candidates: PUI AS03604MR-N50-R class, Visaton K 36 WP class

Description: Class-D mono amplifier PAM8302A, 2.5 W into 4 ohm at 5 V (Adafruit 2130 breakout or bare IC)
Notes: Doorbell v0.8: XIAO 5V -> VIN (SD tied to VIN; the 5V pin is USB only, so the speaker is silent on the LiPo ride-through), XIAO D3 (PWM audio) -> R6/C3/R7/C5 filter -> C4 -> R8/R9 divider -> A+; A- through 1 uF to GND; + / - to SPK1. Parks on edge beside the button, taped to the -X wall. Fixed 24 dB gain: the divider keeps the XIAO's swing at ~0.6 V peak

Description: Resistor 1k ohm 1/4W (speaker PWM filter, R6 + R7)
Notes: Two RC poles (R6/C3, R7/C5) at ~7 kHz: the 78 kHz PWM carrier drops ~40 dB before AMP1

Description: Capacitor 22nF 50V ceramic (speaker PWM filter, C3 + C5)
Notes: With R6/R7: the audio filter's two poles

Description: Capacitor 1uF 50V film or ceramic (audio coupling, A+ and A-)
Notes: Blocks the PWM's mid-scale DC so the amplifier and the driver never see it; the second couples A- to GND

Description: Resistor 10k ohm 1/4W (audio divider, top)
Notes: R8/R9 after C4: ~0.6 V peak into AMP1's 24 dB

Description: Resistor 2.2k ohm 1/4W (audio divider, bottom)
Notes: R8/R9 after C4

Description: Foam gasket ring 36 mm OD / 30 mm ID x 1.5 mm, closed-cell (speaker rim to the face)
Notes: Doorbell v0.8: inside the face's speaker boss, under the driver's rim; the acoustic seal and the anti-rattle

Description: Foam pad 20 mm x 1.5 mm, closed-cell (speaker magnet to the plate's cradle)
Notes: Doorbell v0.8: the cradle presses the magnet through it when the plate screws down

Description: Acoustic mesh patch, 34 mm, hydrophobic, adhesive (speaker grille; Saati Acoustex class)
Notes: Doorbell v0.8: on the face's INNER side over the Ø1.0 grille holes, in its 0.3 mm seat; rain stays out, sound goes through. Not a GORE pressure vent - that is VNT1 on the vent cluster
